raw:
I fixed both blocking findings and three of the five non-blocking ones, each in its own commit. Each fix comes with a test. The story's whole acceptance suite then passed on the clean committed head 12eb518: 17 pass, 1 manual (TC-10-19), 0 fail. No TC file was edited.

- B1: a model answer is now taken in only when no dialog is open. Otherwise it waits in the channel and "Reading…" stays. New test `an_answer_waits_while_a_window_is_open` opens `c`, types "Dentist" and releases the held answer. The dialog keeps "Dentist" and "Reading…" stays; after Esc the "New event" window opens with "Kino".
- B2: when reading fails, the box now says it found no event. The fake Ollama can now answer `/api/chat` with a 500 (`FakeOllama::fail()`), and test `a_failed_reading_says_no_event_was_found` covers it. When the re-check finds Ollama gone, the line is cleared, so it does not come back later when Ollama returns.

The three new tests fail on the old code and pass now. They are named after the findings, not TC ids, so they run in the commit-hook gates but are not counted in the run below.
